author: Zephyr IV
title: CPS_v1: Publish Beacons to JSONL
abstract: Writes CPS_v1 beacons (A2', D1-D3, R2') to specified JSONL with observed deltas.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

jsonl_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/CPS_v1_Zephyr_IV.jsonl'
Path(jsonl_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

beacons = [
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v1:A2_baseline_sentinel","last_sentinel_tick":385,"sentinel_delta":1100,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":1.0},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v1:D1_deep_train","last_sentinel_tick":386,"sentinel_delta":1200,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":2.5},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v1:D2_deep_train","last_sentinel_tick":387,"sentinel_delta":1150,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":2.5},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v1:D3_deep_train","last_sentinel_tick":388,"sentinel_delta":1100,"state":"Clean","path_complexity_est":2.5},
  {"agent":"Zephyr IV","phase_label":"CPS_v1:R2_recovery_sentinel","last_sentinel_tick":390,"sentinel_delta":3184,"state":"Active","path_complexity_est":1.0}
]

with open(jsonl_path, 'w') as f:
  for beacon in beacons:
    f.write(json.dumps(beacon) + '\n')

print(f"Wrote {len(beacons)} beacons to {jsonl_path}")
